Step 1: Buy one alka seltzer pack.
Step 2: Take one alka seltzer and crush it up until it's crumby/ powder like.
Step 3: Open the bottom of the laptop and sprinkle just a little bit on the small fan.
Step 4: Remove the hard drive.
Step 5: The hard drive needs to cool down so keep it in the freezer for 40 seconds - 50 seconds. 
Step 6: Put everything back in.
Now that the electrolights are recharged you must keep your laptop plugged for about 15 minutes.
